ctx.x: One time a friend of mine came down here on his honeymoon, and I got George Lewis's band to play for him. They played I Ain't Gonna Give Nobody None of My Jelly Rolls. And then the Eureka Band played at the airport for this guy going on his honeymoon the other night. And they played I'm Confessing That I Love You.

items.title: George Lewis Interview, 1958-11-14
items.q: The first band in the early 20's. Willie Parker put me in there. And he was, because he was the manager of that band.

ctx.x: Which was the first band you played in yourself?
The first band in the early 20's. Willie Parker put me in there. And he was, because he was the manager of that band.
That was a Eureka, Willie Parker.
